query: Периодически выбирай новые записи из PostgreSQL и публикуй их в Kafka topic analytics.events в формате JSON.

runs.yaml_pim:
flow:
  id: pg_kafka_periodic_sync
  name: PostgreSQL to Kafka Periodic Sync
  description: Periodically extracts new records from PostgreSQL and publishes them
    to Kafka topic analytics.events in JSON format.
triggers:
- id: trigger_schedule
  type: schedule
  condition: every 10 minutes
sources:
- id: source_postgres
  name: Read from PostgreSQL
  type: PostgreSQL
  location: '{{PG_TABLE_NAME}}'
  connection:
    properties:
      host: '{{DB_HOST}}'
      port: '{{DB_PORT}}'
      database: '{{DB_NAME}}'
      username: '{{DB_USERNAME}}'
      password: '{{DB_PASSWORD}}'
processing_elements:
- id: process_transform
  name: Filter New Records & Format JSON
  operation: Transform
  config:
    incremental_logic: select_new_records
    output_format: json
sinks:
- id: sink_kafka
  name: Publish to Kafka
  type: Kafka
  location: analytics.events
  connection:
    properties:
      brokers: '{{KAFKA_BROKERS}}'
processed_data:
- id: events_json
  format: json
links:
- from_id: source_postgres
  to_id: process_transform
  data_ref: events_json
- from_id: process_transform
  to_id: sink_kafka
  data_ref: events_json
